Messages.Author: David Kiker
Messages.Body:
As September fades into October I feel the need
to ask (even beg) for information.

Does anyone know when the second batch of Jyhad cards is going
to be available? (even roughly!!)

I pre-ordered a bunch of Jyhad cards BUT the first batch were sold
out by my supplier before my order was filled. The second batch was
supposed to be September BUT I assume that has changed.

Any info would be greatly appreciated (though if the fabulous
Belgian printers Carta Mundi, have not finished printing them
yet I am likely to be depressed).

I really like this game and am getting by on a few cards I picked
up locally.

David Kiker
kdk@template.com

Thanks for any help.
